dependencies.similar: 2 (Apache-2.0), default features off, text only; replaces the donor's diff and parse-diff packages

files.adapted: createMarkdownChangeDiff: a unified diff of previous.md against current.md with three lines of context, its structured form (hunks of add, del and normal lines with line numbers), and no result when no line changed
files.changes: similar (Myers, with a deadline) instead of diff and parse-diff; the diff is cut at the extraction bound and marked truncated; a workspace-scoped store of the last extraction per canonical URL (no fragment), bounded to 256 pages and 64 MiB, least recently tracked evicted first, written atomically, refused (not replaced) when corrupt, with forget and clear

authority_delta: None: stored and returned text is still untrusted page text in the caller's workspace.
residuals: The store and diff are host-crate API; the extract surface does not yet take track_changes (same core-first pattern as WI-01 to WI-03).
